item.title: Codex CLI adds durable sessions that survive restarts
item.description: Codex CLI 2.4 is available now with durable sessions. Runs survive restarts and resume from a checkpoint. The release notes list the new resume command and a migration guide for existing session files.

item.title: Insiders say a secret agent will replace every engineer next month
item.description: Insiders claim the secret model is 100x smarter and a total game changer. No benchmarks, no release date, but investors call it revolutionary and AGI is basically here.
